name: Gentleman's Proposal
storyline:
With four intriguing men vying for your attention, the stakes have never been higher.
Your arranged marriage to a wealthy older man looms, and only finding the right suitor can free you from this fate!

Thanks to a royal contract, you’ve made a dazzling debut.
But when the season ends, will you have received the perfect proposal?

Dive into thrilling, passionate affairs and compete for the affection of these captivating men.
Can you escape your arranged marriage and secure your happily-ever-after?
Find out in Gentleman’s Proposal, the ultimate spicy romance fantasy otome game!
summary: Can’t find the right groom? You're headed for an arranged marriage with a rich old man! But suddenly, four irresistible suitors appear in your life... Could one of them be your way out? Set in the glamorous 19th-century English social scene, where romance and passion are never far away, you must navigate thrilling encounters as a strong, bold young woman. Can you find your 'perfect proposal' before time runs out?
